candidate_axiom.name: Demarcated Exception Enclaves & Bounded Invariant Suspension
candidate_axiom.statement: Any necessary violation or edge-case bypass of an active architectural invariant must be confined within an explicitly demarcated Exception Enclave; enclaves must isolate the failure blast radius, emit machine-readable dissipation audit witnesses, and prohibit unverified state leakage to outer composable scopes.
candidate_axiom.operational_rule: Undemarcated or unisolated invariant breaches trigger immediate compile-time failure. Invariant suspensions are permitted only inside declared enclave wrappers with cryptographic dissipation logs and localized error boundaries.

metadata.exogenous_domain: Theoretical Computer Science & Monadic Enclave Theory (The `unsafe` Principle)
metadata.source_principle: Bounded Invariant Suspension & Isolated Blast Radius Containment

system_profile.topology_type: Isolated Enclave Boundary with Cryptographic Audit Conduit
system_profile.topology_diagram:
[Edge-Case Mutation Intent] ──> [Enclave Entry Barrier]
                                              │
                                              ▼
                             [Bounded Invariant Suspension Scope]
                                              │
                               ┌──────────────┴──────────────┐
                               ▼                             ▼
                 [Cryptographic Audit Log]      [Humane Error Recovery Adapter]
                               │                             │
                               ▼                             ▼
                 [Audit Dissipation Witness]    [Graceful Persona Fallback]

Enclave Isolation Membrane.role: Confines unverified edge-case operations within an impermeable scope boundary; catches unhandled exceptions and prevents outer state corruption.
Enclave Isolation Membrane.invariant_rule: Scope boundary must catch all faults; zero unhandled error leakage permitted.

Invariant Suspension Auditor.role: Emits cryptographic dissipation audit witnesses detailing why and where the invariant was suspended.
Invariant Suspension Auditor.invariant_rule: Enclave execution without machine-readable justification is rejected.

Humane Error Recovery Adapter.role: Translates low-level enclave faults into graceful, actionable persona-oriented remediation paths instead of crashing the product.
Humane Error Recovery Adapter.invariant_rule: Raw compiler or database dumps are intercepted and transformed into user-friendly guidance.

target_behaviors.target_1_self_constructor: Permits necessary low-level runtime escapes (FFI, memory flush, raw socket I/O) without invalidating global compiler proofs (+0.0150).
target_behaviors.target_2_self_evaluator: Captures structured dissipation logs for all edge cases (+0.0135).
target_behaviors.target_3_control_group: Enables emergency split-brain recovery and partition fencing in distributed consensus (+0.0140).
target_behaviors.target_4_product_usability: Prevents catastrophic crashes, providing graceful fallback and gentle user recovery (+0.0165).

tradeoffs.strengths: Eliminates mathematical fragility; allows real-world edge-case handling without sacrificing zero-trust guarantees.
tradeoffs.constraints: Enclave usage must be audited and minimized to prevent abuse as an architectural shortcut.
